items.title: Meta Ads: $242.94 spend, 17 leads, $14.29 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: The most recent prior meta-ads.json (2026-09-02) covered spend through 2026-09-01, so this run widened from the standard --days 1 to --days 5 (2026-09-02 through 2026-09-06) to close the 5-day gap in daily-ingest runs. Over that window Meta spent $242.94, entirely on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 17 leads at $14.29 CPL. CPL is below the 7-day baseline (2026-08-31 to 2026-09-06: $339.97 / 20 leads, ~$17.00 CPL), so no anomaly; account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Window widened: the most recent prior meta-ads.json was 2026-09-02, covering spend through 2026-09-01 (no daily-ingest runs 2026-09-03 through 2026-09-06). Per policy this run widened from the standard yesterday-only pull to 5 days (2026-09-02 through 2026-09-06) to cover the gap rather than missing those days entirely.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 17 in this window, 20 in the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times, same as flagged on 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-02). No discrepancy in the counted total so far, but this recurrence across three runs suggests the script's lead-action set should be reviewed for extension rather than continuing to hand-note it each run.
